run_googletest_list_tests: run the googletest-list-tests-unittest_ binary with args and capture the printed test list output
test_default_behavior: test the default mode behavior of gtest_list_tests when the flag is not set
test_list_tests_flag: test the gtest_list_tests flag by verifying output matches expected regex when enabled or disabled
test_override_non_filter_flags: test that gtest_list_tests overrides non-filter flags like gtest_break_on_failure
test_with_filter_flags: test that gtest_list_tests respects the gtest_filter flag to filter listed test names
